title: Language models can explain neurons in language models
whyNeeded: The automated interpretability pipeline is this protocol adapted: explain a unit from examples, then simulate its activations from the explanation alone, quantized 0-9, scored by correlation. This paper states its deviations (its own sampling, its own handling of constant predictions, importance weighting) without restating the baseline, so the original setup is needed to read the scores.

title: A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits
whyNeeded: The central downstream measurement, the logit weight $d_i W_{down} \pi L W_{unembed}$, is defined only by reference to this framework's path expansion and its treatment of layer norm as a fixed projection plus diagonal scaling. Reproducing or trusting every logit weight plot depends on those two mechanics.

title: Toy Models of Superposition
whyNeeded: Supplies the machinery this paper builds on and then revises: the superposition hypothesis, noisy simulation of a larger sparse network, the geometry of feature directions and interference, the three strategies for resolving superposition, and the toy setups used here as ground truth for the autoencoder.

title: Curve Detectors
whyNeeded: The expected value plot, an activation histogram weighted by activation magnitude, is taken from here and carries the argument that impure weak activations do not matter much; the same source supplies the causality/generality/purity desiderata the decomposition criteria are modeled on. How the weighting is built decides how much that argument can bear.

title: Superposition, Memorization, and Double Descent
whyNeeded: The reading of the phrase-memorizing features in 5.4 imports this work's account of memorization in superposition wholesale, including what a memorized datapoint looks like as a direction and where the memorization/generalization boundary sits. Nothing of the mechanism is restated here.
